reason: rejected before any sandbox: the body uses {path}, which no precondition's probe references; a precondition is how a program declares what it needs, so a body parameter that no precondition names is a program that has not said what it requires -- the states it may fire in need not bind it

refused_program.intent: Resolve a dependency-file merge conflict by taking upstream's version and re-adding the local pure additions.

postconditions.description: the index has no unmerged entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_entries

postconditions.description: upstream's branch is now an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor_of_head

postconditions.description: no unresolved changes remain in the worktree
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: the remote-tracking branch for upstream exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_branch_ref_exists

preconditions.description: either a merge is in progress with unmerged files, or local and upstream have both modified a common file since their merge base
preconditions.name: diverged_or_conflicted
preconditions.probe:
if [ -f .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then
  git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -q .
else
  base=$(git merge-base HEAD "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}") || exit 1
  comm -12 \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
fi

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean unless a merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: clean_or_merge_in_progress
preconditions.probe:
if [ -f .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then
  exit 0
fi
! git status --porcelain | grep -q .
